text: BLOGEMERT, Abraham, painter of landscape, cattle, history, and portraits, was born at Cororm in 1561, according to Hunkers. has according to Sud-drart, whose authority seems to claim the preference, he was born in 1557, and lived mostly in Utrecht. In this youth he rapidly himself differently to design after the works of Francis Floris, and afterwards received instructions from several artists of no great repute but the power of his own gains proved his principal de- rector in the art of painting. He formed a manner peculiar to himself, making nature his model for many of the objects be painted, particularly the cattle, in which he excelled. He died in 1647. He left four
